title: Quantum Koopman Algorithms
summary: Solving high-dimensional dynamical systems by encoding their state in the amplitudes of a quantum state is expected to be a core application of fault-tolerant quantum computers. However, the conditions under which this paradigm yields quantum advantage can be restrictive, motivating complementary approaches. Here, we introduce Quantum Koopman Algorithms, where quantum amplitudes encode approximately closed sets of observables for a linear or nonlinear dynamics.
